compatibility_observations: FDBanner screenshot inspected and coloured FreeDOS banner confirmed.
B64 output is QUJDRA== followed by CRLF; byte-exact exported output checked.
TSORT output checked byte-for-byte. SAL output is 87 bytes, SHA256 matches the previously verified macro.
utf8tocp CP775 output matches independently encoded Lithuanian letters byte-for-byte.
Search finds both root/nested matches exactly once.
limitations: Only PIT channel 2, binary mode 3, low/high-byte count transfers and counter latch implemented; other channels/modes/BCD/read-back fault.
No audio playback backend; logical tone/gate/OUT2 state is emulated.
Synthetic instruction-clock timing; completed reload applies immediately, not at a cycle boundary.
Windows installation still incomplete; UI now reports inability to create the specified directory. The exact failing DOS directory-service path was not isolated in this change.
Original archives and executables unchanged; no APK rebuild or release.
